rust_summary: the numeric id of a registry name (`native_registry_id`), the reverse of `native_registry_name`, so a mod can put a particle, sound, item or entity type into a packet by id.
doc_summary: `native_registry_id(registry, name)` (`host.registry_id`) gives the protocol id of a name in a registry, the reverse of `native_registry_name`. Bundles need "hooks": @API:registry_id@.
